upstream_review.message:
feat: add row drawing, region views, lint and export tools from session analysis

Gaps found by reading four Opus 5.5 drawing sessions, where agents kept
rebuilding these in Lua:

- draw_rows / read_rows: draw and read pixels as character rows with a
  colour legend, rejecting ragged rows; optional outline
- view_sprite region="x,y,w,h" with sprite-coordinate rulers, and a
  larger auto-zoom for multi-frame views
- export_animation: scaled GIF/PNG export on an optional background
  without touching the source sprite
- get_bounds, plus layer_name/region filters on compare_frames
- outline_cel region, lint_sprite (detached pieces, lone pixels,
  stray colours), draw_iso_box
- Instructions point at view_sprite, list tools to reach for before Lua,
  and cover small organic parts, scene size, objects resting on surfaces
  and soft-body squash and stretch; run_lua_script is now a last resort;
  animation_workflow_guide gains an idle use case
- README tool tables cover all 123 tools

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
